note: titleOf(firstUserText); conversationClean(raw) -> record | null (id /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$/); conversationsKeep(entries) -> {keep (display order), evict (ids in eviction order, oldest first)}.

title.name: a line separator folds, a bidi mark goes
a path in the first message shows its last part
a backslash path shows its last part too
a path word is judged by the part that is shown: a long path keeps its last part
a path whose last part is a key is dropped
a key in a middle segment of a path is dropped too
a slash-joined secret that does not start a path is dropped whole
a secret word is dropped, the rest stays
a word with password is dropped
a query part of an address goes, with its secret
a card number over several words is kept: the rule is per word

clean.name: a bad id is no record
an upper-case id is no record
a missing title comes from the first user message
pinned only when true; updatedAt never before createdAt
a bad role goes; files keep their names only
a caption of 80 emoji is kept whole
a caption of 81 emoji: 79 and an ellipsis
a file name of 61 emoji: 59 and an ellipsis
a caption of 81 code points is cut to 80
twelve file names: the first ten, each at most 60 code points
a conversation of 1005 messages keeps the newest 1000
a text of 100,005 code points is cut to 100,000

keep.name: a duplicate id keeps its newest
over fifty: the oldest unpinned go
fifty pinned: a new unpinned conversation is dropped at once
